## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- All styling lives in `style.css`. The `style="..."` attribute is **forbidden** anywhere in `index.html`.
- All design properties, layout rules, and states are targeted via class/ID selectors only.
- HTML stays semantic and style-agnostic — re-skinning the site must require editing CSS only, never the markup.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens**
- Define all tokens in `:root` (light) and override under a `.dark` class (plus a `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` block guarded so saved preferences win): `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success` (light `#16A34A` / dark `#4ADE80`), `--text-error` (light `#DC2626` / dark `#F87171`), `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`, `--radius-sm` (8px), `--radius-md` (16px), `--radius-lg` (40px — the Shipping section's bottom corners), `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md`, `--spacing-gap` (60px — marquee item gap), `--transition-fast` (150ms), `--transition-normal` (400ms), `--ease-standard` (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`), `--z-dropdown` (1000), `--z-modal` (2000), `--z-toast` (3000), `--font-base` (`'Inter', sans-serif`).
- Apply the contrast pairing of §0.2 in every theme.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support**
- Dark mode is a first-class theme. Persist the user's choice in `localStorage` (key: `framelix-theme`), falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit.
- Provide a visible toggle (sun/moon Material Symbols) with correct `aria-pressed` state and `aria-label="Toggle dark mode"`. Switching themes swaps CSS variables only — no HTML restructuring.
- Both themes must pass WCAG AA contrast; the hero video carries a gradient scrim in both themes so overlay text stays readable.

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
- Build all layout structure with Flexbox. Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment.
- Mobile-first responsiveness: nav columns, feature rows, steps, pricing tiers, and footer columns stack into single columns on small viewports. No horizontal scrolling at any width — the marquee wrapper is `overflow: hidden` and videos are width-capped.

**1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration**
- Use Tailwind CSS (Play CDN or build) with component classes defined via `@layer components` / `@apply` in `style.css`: `.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`, `.marquee`, `.nav`, `.step`, `.faq-item`, `.modal`. Utilities and components must resolve to the CSS variables — no hardcoded hex values inside component classes, no arbitrary color utilities in markup.

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
- Inter via Google Fonts `<link>`; icons via **Google Material Symbols** (variable font).
- The ticket mark uses the `confirmation_number` Material Symbol.
- Raw inline SVGs, icon fonts, and local icon files are forbidden. **Exception clause:** the source spec requests a ticket SVG — a single bespoke inline SVG is permitted for the ticket logo mark only if a custom glyph is essential; every other icon must remain a Material Symbol.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Button Component Requirements** — `.btn` + `.btn--primary` / `.btn--ghost` / `.btn--danger`:
- **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px, Inter 600.
- **Hover:** brightness/shadow shift + `cursor: pointer`.
- **Focus:** distinct lavender ring via `box-shadow` using `--primary` for keyboard navigation.
- **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- **Loading** (`aria-busy="true"`): blocks pointer events, prevents double-clicks, renders a CSS spinner without changing button dimensions.
- **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- **Success/Error:** temporary feedback states tinted by `--text-success` / `--text-error`.
- Required instances: hero "Explore" (ghost over video) and "Buy Now" (primary — Shipping, Pricing, nav CTA).

**2.2 Card Component Requirements** — powers Features, How It Works steps, Testimonials, Pricing:
- **Default:** flex layout on `--bg-secondary`, 1px `--border-default`, `--radius-md`, `--shadow-sm`.
- **Hover:** elevation shift + `transform: translateY(-2px)`.
- **Focus-within:** lavender border when a child link/button receives focus.
- **Loading:** shimmer skeleton keyframes preserving layout height (no jumps).
- **Empty state:** centered Material Symbol + guidance text fallback.
- Pricing middle tier: `.card--featured` with lavender border, "Most Popular" badge, and desktop scale-up.

**2.3 Form & Input Requirements** — Final CTA email capture:

- **States:** empty, focused (lavender outline ring), filled, valid (success border + `check_circle` icon), invalid (error border + `error` icon + message in `--text-error`), disabled, read-only.
- Validate in `script.js` with inline per-field messages; never rely on color alone — pair icon + text.

**2.4 Modal / Popup Requirements** — "Buy Now" order modal:
- **States:** opening, open, loading, success/error, closing — all animated via CSS transitions (`--transition-normal`).
- **UX:** centered flex overlay (`align-items: center`), blurred dark backdrop, Material Symbol `close` button, keyboard focus trapping, close via `Esc` and backdrop click, focus returns to the trigger; `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by default:** fluid `clamp()` typography, standard breakpoints, zero horizontal overflow anywhere (marquee and videos included).
- **Smooth animations:** every state change transitions with `var(--transition-normal)`. Entrance choreography is Framer-Motion-style fade+slide — opacity 0→1, `translateY(24px)` → 0, **0.8s**, `--ease-standard`, staggered — implemented as CSS classes toggled by an `IntersectionObserver` in `script.js`. **Exception clause:** the source spec references Framer Motion (a React library); do not introduce React — replicate its fade+slide timing in vanilla CSS/JS exactly as specified here.
- **Reduced motion:** `prefers-reduced-motion` disables the marquee animation, entrance slides, and hero video autoplay; all content remains fully visible and reachable.
- **Accessibility:** WCAG AA contrast in both themes; semantic HTML5 landmarks (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `footer`); skip-to-content link; correct ARIA roles/labels on the theme toggle, mobile menu, accordion, and modal; logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability (no mouse-only interactions); `aria-live` regions for form errors, modal status, and CTA feedback. Never communicate state by color alone.
- **Mandatory visual feedback:** every click, hover, focus, and submission triggers a visible state change.
- **Destructive actions:** any destructive control (e.g., "Clear form") uses `.btn--danger` with `--text-error` / `--border-error` styling, visually distinct in both themes.
